paragraphs: Imperio Distribution LLC recalled 2 oz. bags of IMPERIO FUEGO BEEF JERKY (CARNE SECA) distributed in Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, and Wisconsin because the product was produced without federal inspection [1][32]. Made Fresh Salads Inc recalled 5 lb. white plastic tubs of Made Fresh brand Black Bean and Corn Salad sold in New York due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [2]. Deano's Pasta recalled 1 lb. packages of Pear and Pecorino Triangoli Ravioli in Massachusetts and New Hampshire because the product contains undeclared lobster [3]. These are Class I recalls [1][2][3].

Taylor Farms issued a recall for H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad kits due to potential undeclared soy and tree nuts (almonds) [9][18]. HAIFA SMOKED FISH recalled approximately 560 pounds of Cold Smoked Sprats due to potential contamination with Clostridium botulinum, a bacterium which can cause life-threatening illness, and consumers are warned not to use the product even if it does not look or smell spoiled [10].

Additional Class II recalls included Stewart's Shops Vanilla Heavenly Medley ice cream with potential metal pieces [4], J. HIGGS Loaded Bacon & Cheddar Potato Chips with undeclared soy [5], Daring Plant Steak Bites with defective packaging that can rupture during cooking [6], and Holsum Spinach Flour Tortillas with undeclared food colors [7]. Natural Grocers Brand Organic 2 Pound Mung Beans were recalled for potential glass contamination [11], and WinCo Foods Brand Hoagie Rolls were recalled for undeclared sesame [12].
